observed: Eight hook trials each used a separate process and newly compiled caller code.
monitor_only:5 INSTRUCTION/1 CALL; monitor_then_profile:0 INSTRUCTION/1 CALL/4 PROFILE; profile_then_monitor:5 INSTRUCTION/1 CALL/4 PROFILE.
Reinstalling the same profile or removing/restoring it preserved delivery in these trials; replacing profile retained INSTRUCTION but changed profile recipient.
Replacing INSTRUCTION callback kept queried profile/tool/global/local masks unchanged while the original callback lost its five instruction deliveries.
register_callback changes produced audit events; local mask off/restore produced no matching audit event in this trial, and instruction delivery disappeared/reappeared.
Exact original probe copied to this directory reproduced 154 events/15 attempts/9 conditional routes and all five assertions.
sys._getframe, frame.f_code and function.__code__/__defaults__/__kwdefaults__ triggered audit events and therefore can invoke already installed Python audit hooks.

pre_load: pre-load observation is not stack result
inferred_production_protocol.first_supported_rule: Exact raw FunctionType observed before validated LOAD_FAST/LOAD_GLOBAL, fixed positional explicit FAST_LOCAL Name occurrences supplying every formal, no receiver/default/adapter/packing consumption, synchronous direct entry. Route by occurrence and position; reference equality only rejects inconsistency.
inferred_production_protocol.flow_rule: Validate the dynamic instruction window for this attempt. Do not choose the latest same-name/span load from the entire invocation, or any same-token occurrence from the trace.
inferred_production_protocol.hook_policy: Install profile before local CALL/INSTRUCTION configuration; audit profile/callback changes where observed, poll profile/tool/masks, and require every needed occurrence/entry. Configuration equality or audit silence does not certify continuity.
inferred_production_protocol.observation_policy: Never reevaluate callee/actual AST, call target helpers, enumerate arbitrary user containers, invoke repr/equality/hash/descriptor protocols, or inspect signature via adapters. Exact builtin access only; bound/safe reads and weak lifetime identity, no tensor contents. Audit/frame/namespace interposition remains explicit.

conditions_unknown: observer/audit noninterference and hook continuity outside established records
remaining_boundaries: No evaluated value-stack operands or full argument vector are exposed by these callbacks.
CALL callable/arg0 does not distinguish raw function from hidden receiver normalization; same-code/same-ref/default alias remains ambiguous without pre-load shape.
LOAD_ATTR/descriptor results, bound/partial/default/keyword/star packing, async/generator/native calls and untracked caller paths remain outside the first binding rule.
Snapshot tokens are event-local; no cross-event identity or provenance follows from them.
Function code/layout must be checked at dispatch/entry; load-time layout may have changed during actual evaluation.
Dynamic first-encounter instrumentation enabled inside a profile callback was not separately tested in this review; startup-configured fresh code is the directly measured case.
Strong diagnostic references in the original probe affect object lifetimes; production must not copy that identity table.
No public observer scheme here proves absence of all hook/audit/namespace interference or establishes function environment/content/effects/purity.
